Collections taken from the middle section of the Mountaineer Creek drainage between Spencer Basin in the west and the waterfall in the east where the stream tumbles into Cunningham Gulch. This middle section possesses 2 moderately large knolls that have northern exposures of gneissic rock, both of which occur along the stream. A small tarn is located on the S side of Mountaineer Creek about 100 yards E of one knoll.
